review_findings.conclusion: The shared argv builder emits the exact global windows.sandbox="mxc" once. Permission profile remains root deny, minimal read, selected workspace read, network disabled, approval never and extensions disabled. Config identity hashes this same builder with Host source/cwd placeholders; it is a requested-config identity, not effective managed permission proof.

Capabilities/Submit, scan, launch/gate, BeforeResume and driver Start use the shared predicate with freshly obtained readiness and canonical expected identity. Descriptor failure, any nonempty snapshot reason, non-READY state or any identity-field mismatch rejects. Driver checks again while its child is suspended before calling Host BeforeResume.

Ordinary NewCodexCLI exposes UNVERIFIED readiness. The unchanged actual Host calls that constructor. The separate Go-only fixture constructor is used by trusted test composition; no environment, JSON, HTTP or renderer READY import was added. PermissionOverrides now reject nonempty values.

New Host-sealed task input binds ref, principal, project, requested READ_ONLY, actual binding access, revision and canonical RealPath digest. Admission, scan and launch gates compare the snapshot. BeforeResume additionally compares the fresh binding RealPath and revision against the exact binding used to populate driver Start input; a valid replacement path cannot authorize the previously selected path.

The existing launchWithCallback lifecycle calls BeforeResume before ResumeThread and terminates the owned Job on callback failure. The new rebind counterexample observes one start, no result/assistant content, and no second start after another Scan. Existing claim, identity and stop fences remain in place.

Internal v2 sandbox/command/revision/mode/profile/hash fields are required; registration uses a distinct MXC V2 name and full identity comparisons. Old profile/input without source snapshot cannot gain new admission. Get/List/taskView/harnessTaskInput history readers have no changed body in the supplied baseline patches and do not impose the new snapshot gate on reads. No migration or automatic requeue is added.

No public DTO shape or verification enum is added. The capabilities response preserves profile_id codex-workspace-read-v1, UNVERIFIED verification values, and enforcement_verified=false; only can_submit/reason_codes consume the stronger readiness predicate.
